lines.text: Jehoshabeath hid Joash in the house of God for six years while Athaliah ruled the land.
In the seventh year, Jehoiada made a covenant with five commanders, and the assembly made a covenant with the king.
Jehoiada gave the commanders the spears and shields of King Saul, then put the crown on Joash.
Athaliah tore her clothes and screamed "Treason," and she was put to death at the entrance of the Fish Gate.
The people tore down the temple of Baal, and they seated King Joash on the royal throne.
